test_read_data_list: test TextParser with a list of lists and chunksize to read CSV data into a DataFrame
test_reader_list: test TextParser with csv.reader output lines and chunksize to iterate over CSV data chunks

test_reader_list_with_index_col: test TextParser with index_col parameter to set a column as DataFrame index
